title: Ek Dadi Hai Ek Poti
body:
dono ki ajab hai mazloomi
ek dadi hai ek poti hai
ek dukhtare sheh hai
ek binte nabi
<<DIVIDER>>
dadi bhi bhare darbar gayi
poti bhi sare bazaar gayi
dono ko mili hai mehroomi
ek dadi hai ek poti hai
ek dukhtare sheh hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dadi ka bhi pehlu choor hua
poti ka bhi dil ranjoor hua
dono ki hai phasli tooti hui
ek dadi hai ek poti hai
ek dukhtare sheh hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dono hi sidhaari ghut ghut kar
ro paye na apne baba par
dono ki musibat ek jaisi
ek dadi hai ek poti hai
ek dukhtare sheh hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dono ki fazeelat kya mai kahoon
ek baap ki maa ek sheh ka sukoon
dono ke hai mansab ibne jali
ek dadi hai ek poti hai
ek dukhtare sheh hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
dono ko mile ye ranj o mehan
ghar ek ka jala ek ka daaman
dono ko ajab saughaat mili
ek dadi hai ek poti hai
ek dukhtare sheh hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sadiyon se judaai mit na saki
mar kar bhi rehaai mil na saki
dono hai ghamon mein qaid abhi
ek dadi hai ek poti hai
ek dukhtare sheh hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek bibi pe ye zulm hua
ahmed ke khareeb sone na diya
ek seena e sheh se door hui
ek dadi hai ek poti hai
ek dukhtare sheh hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek bibi ne ghar apna diya
ek bibi ne di apni rida
dono ne bachaya deene nabi
ek dadi hai ek poti hai
ek dukhtare sheh hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ay kaash bilal e karbobala
haasil ho tujhe irfan e aza
hai jiski musibat tune likhi
ek dadi hai ek poti hai
ek dukhtare sheh hai...
author: Bilal Kazmi
